subject: general
question: **Choose the sentence with no spelling error.**

options.text: I do not require any technichal knowledge or expertise.
I do not require any technical knowledge or expertise.
I do not require any technical knowlege or expertice.
I do not requir any technical knowledge or expertice.

solution:
The correct sentence is **option 2: "I do not require any technical knowledge or expertise."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because **"technichal"** is **misspelled**.
 
• **Option 3** is incorrect because "**knowlege**" and "**expertice**" are misspelled.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because "**requir**" is misspelled and "**expertice**" is misspelled. 
 
• **Option 2 **is **correct **as all the spellings are correct. The words **"technical", "knowledge", "require" **and** "expertise"** are correctly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Technical **means** **relating to a particular subject, art, or craft, or its techniques.
 
• ​**Knowledge **refers to the information, facts, and understanding that a person possesses about a particular subject or domain.
 
• **Expertise **represents a high level of proficiency, skill, and deep understanding in a specific field or area of knowledge. 
 
• The word** "require"** means **to need, demand, or expect something to be done or fulfilled.**
